metadata.name: 献给阿尔吉侬的花束｜迷宫 01
metadata.extraction: Raster wall extraction from dark strokes; colored route traces mapped to cell centers and validated against wall boundaries.
notes: The two highlighted routes are valid planned routes, not the only possible solutions.
The maze contains loops and additional valid paths.
The route lines are visual annotations; they are not part of the wall geometry.

grid.coordinateConvention: [row, col], origin at top-left, row increases downward, col increases rightward
grid.worldOrigin: top-left outer corner; x increases right, z increases downward, y is height
